posts.company: ยีน & ปันปัน
posts.text:
Sales: Our sales increased by 20% in the last 3 months because more people bought our clothes.
Customers: We got 30% more new customers this year, especially young people.
Prices: We increased our prices by 10% this year because material costs went up.
Costs: Our costs increased by 15% this year because of higher rent and material prices.
Online: Our online followers increased by 50% in 6 months, and online orders also increased.
Branches & staff: We opened 2 new branches this year and hired 5 more employees.

Sales: Our monthly sales increased by 25% last month, reaching 150,000 baht.
Customers: We gained 50 new regular customers and saw a 30% rise in online orders this week.
Prices: We increased our coffee price by 10 baht last month, while our ingredient costs rose by 5%.
Costs: Our overall operating costs increased by 15% due to higher rent and material expenses last quarter.
Online: Our Instagram followers grew by 500 users, and online orders increased by 40% over the past two weeks.
Branches & staff: We opened 1 new branch and hired 3 new staff members at the beginning of this month.

Sales: We sell about 450 units of drinks and bakery items per month, generating an average revenue of 45,000 baht monthly.
Customers: Our customers are mostly students and local workers; 60% are regular visitors, and 40% are new customers ordering via online delivery.
Prices: Our average price is 60-90 baht per item, with ingredient costs accounting for approximately 35% of the selling price.
Costs: Main monthly expenses include 8,000 baht for rent, 6,000 baht for part-time staff, and remaining costs for packaging and materials.
Online: We have over 1,200 followers across social media, averaging 3,000 views per video, and receive 15-20 online orders per week.
Branches & staff: We operate 1 physical store location managed by a core team of 2 people (the owner and a part-time staff member).

Sales: Sales increased steadily from 500 units in 2023 to 3,500 units in 2026.
Customers: The number of customers grew significantly from 300 to 2,200 people.
Prices: Our product prices remained relatively stable at around 150 baht per T-shirt.
Costs: Production costs increased gradually due to higher material and packaging expenses.
Online: Online followers rose dramatically from 500 to 5,000 followers.
Branches & staff: The number of staff increased from 2 to 8 employees as the business expanded.
